svg.text: Vertebrae Detection Methodology for Scoliosis Assessment
Combining CNN and GNN for Enhanced Detection in Noisy Ultrasound Images

g.text: Data Augmentation (Only for Training Data | 50% Chance for each Transformation)
• Warp image grid, also adjust boxes
• Associate noisy samples with cleaner ones
• Extract fixed-size features per bounding box
• Preserves spatial accuracy crucial for vertebrae
• F1: 100% for both Thoracic and Lumbar
Solid lines: high similarity, Dashed: low
